ios.desc:
SafePrompt removes private data and replaces it with placeholders before anything is shared. On your iPhone or iPad it prepares documents for AI and keeps your prompts. Processing stays on your device until you choose to copy or send the result.

What you can do:
- Replace names, email addresses, phone numbers, dates and addresses with clear placeholders
- Keep a library of prompts and combine them with your text
- Import PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, or paste text directly
- Review every change and adjust it before anything leaves your device
- Copy the result or share it with an AI service or chatbot
- Work through several files at once and create a redacted copy of the original

Premium goes further:
- Longer documents
- A larger prompt library
- Bigger batches, up to 50 files
- Unlimited insertion of the original details when you want them back
- Family Sharing, so people in your family can use Premium too

Premium is $0.99 per month, billed to your Apple Account, and renews until you cancel in Apple Account settings. If you bought the original SafePrompt app, Restore Purchases keeps Premium for you.

Automatic detection supports you; please review the result before you share it.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

SafePrompt Mobile is a $0.99 iOS app that strips names, emails, IDs, etc. out of any text before copying it to ChatGPT or any other platform. Also lets you save prompt templates for one-tap reuse.

You can try for free on TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/7zc7dha9
